([[Espergærde]], Denmark) | college = * [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State]] (2017–2020) * [[Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball|Grand Canyon]] (2020–2021) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2014 | years1 = 2014–2017 | team1 = [[Hørsholm 79ers]] | years2 = 2021–2022 | team2 = [[ZZ Leiden]] | years3 = 2022–2023 | team3 = [[Crailsheim Merlins]] | years4 = 2023 | team4 = [[Antwerp Giants]] | highlights = * [[BNXT League]] champion (2022) * [[BNXT League Dream Team]] ([[2021–22 BNXT League|2022]]) * [[Dutch Basketball Supercup|Dutch Supercup]] champion ([[2021 Dutch Basketball Supercup|2021]]) * [[Basketligaen]] Young Player of the Year (2017) * First-team All-[[Western Athletic Conference|WAC]] (2021) * WAC Newcomer of the Year (2021) * WAC All-Defensive Team (2021) }} '''Asbjørn Engelhardt Midtgaard''' (born 20 September 1997) is a Danish professional [[basketball]] player. He last played for the [[Antwerp Giants]] of the [[BNXT League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State Shockers]] and the [[Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball|Grand Canyon Antelopes]]. ==Early life and career== Midtgaard grew up playing [[handball]] and [[association football|football]], as well as [[Olympic weightlifting|weightlifting]] and [[judo]]. He started playing basketball at age 14, and joined the [[Hørsholm 79ers]] of the [[Basketligaen]], the top professional league in Denmark, three years later.{{cite web |last1=Coro |first1=Paul |title=Hoops proved great for Dane |url=https://gculopes.com/news/2020/6/1/mens-basketball-coro-hoops-proved-great-for-dane.aspx |website=Grand Canyon University Athletics |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=1 June 2020}} In the [[2016–17 Basketligaen|2016–17 season]], he averaged 8.6 points and 6.3 rebounds per game and was named Basketligaen Young Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Eldridge |first1=Taylor |title=Danish freshman Asbjorn Midtgaard making impression on WSU |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article178779596.html |website=[[The Wichita Eagle]] |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=15 October 2017}} ==College career== Midtgaard received limited playing time during his three seasons at [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State]]. He averaged 2.7 points and 2.6 rebounds per game in his time with the program.{{cite web |last1=Eldridge |first1=Taylor |title=‘I’m grateful for everything’: Asbjorn Midtgaard credits WSU for breakout season |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article249996244.html |website=[[The Wichita Eagle]] |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=17 March 2021}} For his senior season, he transferred to [[Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball|Grand Canyon]].{{cite web |last1=Obert |first1=Richard |title=Wichita State, 7-foot transfer Asbjorn Midtgaard commits to Grand Canyon basketball |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/gcu/2020/04/11/wichita-state-transfer-asbjorn-midtgaard-commits-grand-canyon-basketball/2977018001/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=11 April 2020}} On 28 November 2020, Midtgaard scored a career-high 20 points in a 94–63 win against [[Benedictine Mesa Redhawks|Benedictine Mesa]].{{cite news |title=Midtgaard leads Grand Canyon over Benedictine Mesa 94–63 |url=https://apnews.com/article/basketball-canyons-asbjorn-midtgaard-gabe-mcglothan-chance-mcmillian-7f1f1c3cdf784a35aba614689f6bd971 |access-date=10 August 2021 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=28 November 2020}} As a senior, Midtgaard averaged 14.2 points, 9.7 rebounds and 1.3 blocks per game, and shot an [[NCAA Division I]]-best 70.7 percent from the field.{{cite web |last1=Obert |first1=Richard |title=Asbjorn Midtgaard first Grand Canyon player in D-I era invited to NBA Summer League, joining Orlando Magic |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/gcu/2021/07/30/midtgaard-first-gcu-player-d-i-era-invited-nba-summer-league/5432900001/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=30 July 2021}} He received First Team All-[[Western Athletic Conference]], Newcomer of the Year and All-Defensive Team honors.{{cite web |last1=Obert |first1=Richard |title=Grand Canyon's Asbjørn Midtgaard, Alessandro Lever, Jovan Blacksher Jr., pick up All-WAC basketball honors |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/college/gcu/2021/03/09/gcus-midtgaard-lever-blacksher-pick-up-wac-hoops-honors/6926947002/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=10 August 2021 |date=9 March 2021}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Midtgaard signed with the [[Orlando Magic]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]]. He became the first Grand Canyon player since the program entered the NCAA Division I to be invited to the Summer League. On 16 August 2021, Midtgaard signed his first professional contract with [[ZZ Leiden]] of the [[BNXT League]].{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/asbjorn-midtgaard-signs-with-zz-leiden/|title=Asbjørn Midtgaard signs with ZZ Leiden|last=|first=|date=16 August 2021|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=16 August 2021}} He was nominated for the [[BNXT League Most Valuable Player]] award and ended third in voting. Midtgaard earned a spot in the All-[[BNXT League]] Dream Team.{{cite web |title=Historic first Award night for betFIRST BNXT League |url=https://bnxtleague.com/en/historic-first-award-night-for-betfirst-bnxt-league/ |website=BNXT League |access-date=30 April 2022 |date=30 April 2022}} On 24 June 2022 he signed a deal with the [[Crailsheim Merlins]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]].{{Cite web |title=Power unter den Körben: Hakro Merlins erzielen Einigung mit Center Midtgaard |url=https://hakro-merlins.com/profis/bbl-news/7375-power-unter-den-koerben-hakro-merlins-erzielen-einigung-mit-center-midtgaard |access-date=2022-07-24 |website=Crailsheim Merlins}} He wrapped up the 2022-23 campaign, averaging 8.1 points and 4.2 rebounds per game in Bundesliga play.{{Cite web |title=Asbjorn Midtgaard |url=https://www.easycredit-bbl.de/spieler/4e6d50e2-ca20-4fea-ae3f-75727d0e7881 |access-date=2023-07-16 |website=Basketball-Bundesliga}} On 16 July 2023 Midtgaard was signed by the [[Antwerp Giants]] of the BNXT League.{{Cite web |date=2023-07-16 |title=Welcome Asbjorn Midtgaard @ Telenet Giants Antwerp! |url=https://antwerpgiants.be/welcome-asbjorn-midtgaard-telenet-giants-antwerp/ |access-date=2023-07-16 |website=Telenet Giants Antwerp |language=nl}} He attended only one BNXT contest for Antwerp and parted ways with the team on 4 October 2023 after having suffered a knee injury.{{Cite web |date=2023-10-04 |title=Les Telenet Giants Antwerp disent au revoir à Asbjorn Midtgaard |url=https://bnxtleague.com/fr/newsvideo/les-telenet-giants-antwerp-disent-au-revoir-a-asbjorn-midtgaard |access-date=2023-10-13 |website=BNXT League}} ==National team career== Midtgaard represented [[Denmark men's national under-18 basketball team|Denmark]] at the [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship Division B]] in Austria, and averaged 7.3 points and 8.4 rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=Asbjoern Engelhardt Midtgaard's profile: 2015 U18 European Championship Men |url=https://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/player/p/pid/107044/sid/11502/tid/271/tid2//_/2015_U18_European_Championship_Men/index.html
